main_text.p: immediatè , saltem mediantibus Nu & Alethia; Verùm ut indicet quisnam fuerit peculiaris Valentini hæresis character, dicit pag. 72. Fabulam Triginta Æonum illi propriam fuisse, decada & duodecada adjecisse opinatur Pearsonius; primam verò Ogdoada à Veteribus accepisse, & ordinem tantùm secundæ tetradis mutâse; sed jam suprà explosimus commentum illud de primâ Ogdoade à Vetustioribus Gnosticis acceptâ; ideóque concidit Viri docti ratiocinatio, quæ prætereà Irenæi narrationi omninò adversatur; quæ dicit de voce μεταχαρακτηρίζειν[?], quòd sæpe simpliciter transferre, aut adaptare significat, non semper, mutare, multò minùs in melius, corrigere scilicet, aut emendare, nihili planè sunt, nec Dallæo quicquam nocent; fatetur enim plerásque Valentini hæresis materias eàsdem esse, quæ vetustiorum Hæreticorum, materiarû verò inter se compositionem ab ijs diversissimam, & hanc harmoniæ & compositionis in aliam formam, seu in alium characterem, mutationem ac translationem, designat apud Irenæum vox μεταχαρακτηρισμὸς[?]. page.notes: The Greek words in the running text are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Both are marked [?]: the first may be μεταχαρακτηρίζειν and the second μεταχαρακτηρισμὸς, but the letters are not clear enough to confirm. "Nu" in the first line is printed in italic, possibly as a Greek nu. The first line of the page continues the previous page's paragraph, and the last word is broken at the line end with a printed hyphen. The "Ff" signature is at the foot, right of centre.
